newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers steady to lower.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers steady to lower.

text.p: North American bunker prices were steady to lower in light trade late this week amid a sharp decline in NYMEX heating oil futures, players said Thursday.
On the Gulf Coast, Houston spot 380 CST dropped $5 a tonne from Tuesday to between $92 a tonne and $93 a tonne. Spot 180 CST was also down $3 to $97/99 a tonne.
"It's going to get worse before it gets better," said one Houston player. "Buyers are hoping 380 will break through the $90 a tonne floor."
